_comment: Governance scenarios calibrated on ../evidence/parameters.json (44 sourced rows, 2026-11-03). audit_detect 0.5/yr under safeguards is an assumption (audits are documented to cut leakage by 8-13 pp, not detection rates).

evidence_basis.sigma: census undercount 10-19% by province (South Africa 2011); PPP revisions
evidence_basis.lag: poverty data ~2 yr publication lag; 1-5 yr range
evidence_basis.leakage: Uganda grants 87%->20%; India PDS 54%->9-28%; Brazil 30%; EU cohesion 9.3%; strong safeguards 3-15%
evidence_basis.misreporting: China local GDP +1.7 pp/yr, Liaoning ~20%; Brazil threshold bunching
